title: 'susi fix' applies every safe auto-fix the doctor found
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. One command runs the doctor and applies safe fixes (ports, hooks, missing dirs, stale locks, key registration prompts), reporting each. Integration test zc_susi_fix.rs.
